scripts.preimport: command -v helm >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '❌ Helm not found. Install via: nix profile install nixpkgs#kubernetes-helm' && exit 1)
scripts.postimport: echo '✅ CRD imports generated. Note: kagent.dev.ts preserved from repository.'
scripts.watch:synth: nodemon --watch charts --watch ../.env-files --ext ts,json --exec '. ../.env-files/wi.env && npx cdk8s synth -a 'npx ts-node main.ts''
scripts.show-env: kubectl get app -n argocd cdk8s-applications -o jsonpath='{.spec.source.plugin.env[*]}' | jq -s '.'
scripts.refresh-app: kubectl patch app -n argocd cdk8s-applications --type merge -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"argocd.argoproj.io/refresh":"hard"}}}'
scripts.reset-apps: make -C .devcontainer/ github-auth-bootstrap SKIP_DEPS=1 && make -C .devcontainer/ gitops-private-apps SKIP_DEPS=1
